description: Common response contract for TabDDPM and LightGBM inference

lightgbm.class_probabilities: object mapping class name to probability

explainability.top_contributing_features: array; populate when explanation is generated

risk_assessment.risk_level: optional; requires a separately validated risk policy

important: TabDDPM anomaly score is not a probability.
LightGBM class probability is not an operational risk score.
SHAP values explain model output and are not causal effects.
Risk and response fields must not be populated using unvalidated assumptions.
